name: What's the difference between a minor update and a major bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a minor update and a major bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor bathroom update typically involves cosmetic changes such as painting, replacing a vanity or toilet, and updating light fixtures. These changes refresh the look without altering the layout or major plumbing/electrical systems. A major renovation, on the other hand, often includes reconfiguring the layout, moving plumbing lines, installing a new shower or tub, and potentially changing the footprint of the bathroom. Major renovations are more extensive in scope and cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor updates are cosmetic changes, while major renovations involve layout changes, plumbing, and extensive structural work.
